Method of Attack: Remote code execution exploiting Jenkins Java deserialization vulnerability CVE-2017-1000353 to download and install Monero mining malware
Impacted Systems: Jenkins servers running on Windows operating systems
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Jenkins RCE vulnerability CVE-2017-1000353 without authentication
Indicators of Compromise: minerxmr.exe downloaded from IP address located in China assigned to Huaian government network
